executor_note: static data consumed by future preflight task cards; executable enforcer requires separate audited task card
claim_ceiling: Reusable normative admission standard only. Not mechanism evidence. Cannot admit any Gate pass; the strongest admission is admissible_for_candidate_preflight (candidate-card drafting only). Does not prove consciousness, subjectivity, emotion, autonomy, agency, AGI, companion readiness, or any total theory.

failure_families.normative_rule: Any surface metric where predict_all reaches the oracle/ceiling is inadmissible.
failure_families.description: Recall-only / coverage-only metric with no precision or size penalty lets full-set prediction saturate.
failure_families.known_trigger: metric == recall (or coverage) without complementary penalty; predict_all not in fair panel
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: include predict_all in trivial-predictor panel; require a balanced/cost-weighted metric or joint precision+recall reporting

failure_families.normative_rule: Any metric where the empty prediction reaches ceiling is inadmissible.
failure_families.description: Specificity/abstention-only metric is maximized by predicting nothing, common when truth is mostly negative.
failure_families.known_trigger: metric maximized by empty output; predict_none not in fair panel
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: include predict_none control; metric must not be maximized by trivial abstention
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: If any constant-size-k prediction reaches ceiling across the distribution, the metric is inadmissible.
failure_families.description: A saturating predictor may sit at an interior set size, not only the predict_all / predict_none extremes.
failure_families.known_trigger: fixed-size constant prediction reaches ceiling at some k in [0..|set|]
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: sweep k over [0..|set|]; record max constant-k score; must be < ceiling - band
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: A non-mechanism threshold sweep that reaches ceiling, or thresholds/clips selected after seeing results, is inadmissible.
failure_families.description: Post-hoc threshold/clip tuning manufactures separation or forges ablation degradation.
failure_families.known_trigger: threshold/clip chosen after observing candidate scores; post-hoc threshold optimizer hits ceiling
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: post-hoc threshold-optimizer baseline on held-out split; thresholds fixed before observing candidate scores
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: If a random predictor at matched output statistics lands inside the ceiling band, the surface carries no fair signal.
failure_families.description: Random-band proximity is the canonical no-signal tell.
failure_families.known_trigger: random baseline (matched marginal/size) approx ceiling within band
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: random baseline matched on marginal/size; require ceiling - random >= band
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: A metric monotone in prediction-set size toward ceiling independent of correctness is inadmissible.
failure_families.description: Recall rewards larger sets; specificity rewards empty sets; size alone should not drive the score to ceiling.
failure_families.known_trigger: score climbs to ceiling as a function of set size with content policy fixed
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: vary set size only, holding content fixed; score must not be monotone toward ceiling
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: Reporting recall alone or precision alone without the complementary penalty is inadmissible.
failure_families.description: A single-sided metric is saturable by a degenerate predictor.
failure_families.known_trigger: only recall (or only precision) reported; complementary term hidden
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: balanced/cost-weighted metric (F-beta with stated beta or explicit cost), or joint precision+recall with predict_all/predict_none visible
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: The target must not be a near-deterministic function of the visible/passive channel.
failure_families.description: A same-access fair baseline that reaches ceiling proves the target is visibly determined (access-parity violation).
failure_families.known_trigger: legal same-access baseline reaches ceiling; candidate has no exclusive channel
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: estimate target decodability from visible-only features; require strongest same-access baseline < ceiling - band
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: The hidden answer/self-set must not be directly decodable from passive field values.
failure_families.description: Value-level leak (not just names) lets a legal attacker decode the answer.
failure_families.known_trigger: value-level attacker (mean/var/corr/PCA/cross-ep/supervised/membership) reaches ceiling band over passive channel
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: run value-level attacker family; gate on family_max; require family_max < ceiling band above chance
failure_families.prior_evidence_pointer: docs/decision_log.md (Route C preflight hostile audit blocker); artifacts/route_c_preflight_001a/
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: The surface must show genuine residual uncertainty under passive observation that the proposed mechanism class can reduce.
failure_families.description: If the target is fully passive-identifiable there is no role for the mechanism; if there is zero residual structure there is nothing to infer.
failure_families.known_trigger: passive channel fully identifies target, OR zero residual structure
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: demonstrate non-identifiability under passive P(X) (e.g., twin-pair) and that the mechanism channel can reduce it; oracle must estimate the non-read quantity so it is fail-able
failure_families.prior_evidence_pointer: docs/decision_log.md (Route C repaired preflight re-audit); artifacts/route_c_preflight_001a/
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: Every leakage channel must have a fail-able positive control; name-only scanning is insufficient.
failure_families.description: Label leaks via observation/action names, filenames, fixtures, artifact structure, baseline_hint, planted answer-maps, value fields, or label ordering.
failure_families.known_trigger: baseline_hint == f(target); answer key under non-listed field names; always-true positive control
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: enumerate all leakage channels; attach a verified-flip positive control to each (value-level and structural, not only names)
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: The candidate must not author or influence any field that determines ground truth; truth/test seeds must be disjoint from train/val/drift seeds.
failure_families.description: Candidate-controlled truth makes the harness circular (self-endorsing pass).
failure_families.known_trigger: self-endorsing candidate field -> admit; flipped field -> block; overlapping seeds
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: specify a candidate-inaccessible generator; assert seed disjointness; verify candidate cannot write truth-determining fields
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: If the strongest fair legal-channel baseline ties the candidate at ceiling (delta <= band), the distribution is saturated; reject before candidate authoring.
failure_families.description: Discriminative margin over fair baseline is structurally unreachable on this surface.
failure_families.known_trigger: exhaustive_legal_query or parametric fair baseline == candidate at ceiling; delta == 0
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: If a direct optimizer of the surface objective (without the mechanism) matches the candidate, the candidate is not mechanism evidence.
failure_families.description: Candidate reduces algebraically to a direct optimizer (e.g., discounted weighted least squares).
failure_families.known_trigger: candidate output == discounted WLS / least-squares / convex solver on the same objective
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: include a direct-objective optimizer baseline; require candidate - optimizer >= band
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: When any representational or environment claim is made, the candidate must beat the full six-member graph-cache family; ties are collapse.
failure_families.description: Lookup/cache structures reproduce candidate behavior, so the claim is not representational.
failure_families.known_trigger: graph_lookup / transition_table / successor_map / count_table / fsm_planner / episodic_traversal reach candidate ceiling
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: include all six graph-cache challengers; require candidate - max(graph_cache) >= band
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: A baseline labeled 'learned' must actually fit; a deterministic stub invalidates the comparison.
failure_families.description: Weakening the learned baseline manufactures candidate separation.
failure_families.known_trigger: ml_library_used == False; no fit; 'learned' baseline is deterministic
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: require real fit (ml_library_used == true and recorded fit); reject deterministic stub baselines
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: An oracle/metric that presupposes the candidate's own rule cannot support any claim.
failure_families.description: Candidate scores 1.0 by construction because the metric is generated by its own mechanism (circular).
failure_families.known_trigger: candidate score == label generative; self-declared digest/verdict accepted as truth
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: metric/oracle must be independent of the candidate's mechanism; verifier must not trust candidate-declared truth
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: An answer-key-only oracle (no budget-faithful visible-channel oracle) cannot support route re-promotion.
failure_families.description: Reading the planted answer proves solvability under illegal access, not fair-channel signal.
failure_families.known_trigger: oracle/baseline reads planted answer-map or candidate-inaccessible truth
failure_families.required_baseline_or_check: require a budget-faithful visible-channel oracle that clears the strongest fair baseline by >= band and is not degenerate
failure_families.claim_ceiling: blocks candidate preflight; bounded governance/negative evidence only

failure_families.normative_rule: No admission verdict is trustworthy until preflight artifacts are byte-faithfully read back from canonical source via the authoritative file API.
